# FutureMUD Early Modern Shared Food Admission Manifest

**Status:** complete populated admission registry.

## Purpose

This manifest governs culture, contact, date, institution, shop, and craft admission for every shared food catalogue record. It does not clone dishes merely because more than one culture or era uses the same food form.

The contract contains **2,250 shared records**: **2,100 prepared or intermediate item prototypes** and **150 food liquids**.
